add.heading: Add to your calendar
add.hint: Or download the file and open it in any calendar app.

connection.justConnected: Your calendar is connected. Upcoming sessions are added automatically.
connection.afterDisconnect: Your calendar is disconnected. Events already added stay as they are, but they will no longer update.

prompt.title: Add your sessions to Google Calendar?
prompt.body: Every session you reserve appears in your calendar automatically and updates if its time changes. You can connect or disconnect later from the calendar page.
